name: Camp Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Teen volunteers help counselors run Conservation Camp for young kids. They set up activities, join in and help make camp fun. They earn service hours and an EcoLeader certificate.
who_can_apply: Teens entering grades 9 to 13 who are 13 to 18 years old by the June start date. The page does not list a city or school rule.
pay_detail: Unpaid service-learning. You get service hours.
duration: About 5 weeks: Session A June 8 to July 17, Session B July 13 to Aug 14 (2026), plus required training days in spring
deadline_text: 2026 application ran Feb 1 to Mar 9. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the Application link on the program page. Two Zoom info sessions were held in Feb and March in 2026.
notes: Camp days run 8 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., Monday to Friday. Required training days are in April, May and June. Teens also get up to 15 Professional Development Sessions and Teen Bonding Nights.
